title: Analyst/Senior Analyst - Governance and Policy Research
description:
**About Pravi**

Pravi is a team of highly motivated, intellectually curious, and impact-oriented professionals working with governments, businesses, development partners, and multilateral institutions to solve complex challenges at scale. We bring together strategists, researchers, technologists, and implementation specialists to turn ambitious ideas into measurable outcomes. We combine analytical rigour with practical execution to help organisations navigate complexity, strengthen capabilities, and deliver sustainable impact. From evidence-based strategy to systems and on-the-ground execution, we work alongside clients as an extension of their teams. 

**Role Overview**

As an Analyst, you will be part of teams supporting government departments and public institutions across multiple policy domains. The role offers hands-on exposure to how policies are framed, approved, budgeted for, and implemented within government systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Dig into Policy Questions:**

  Conduct policy reviews, regulatory analysis, and comparative research to develop sharp policy notes, concept papers, and strategy documents.
* **Turn Priorities into Programmes:**

  Help design government programmes, reform initiatives, and implementation frameworks that respond to departmental and state priorities.
* **Move Projects Forward:**

  Build project charters, implementation roadmaps, review frameworks, and monitoring systems that keep initiatives on track.
* **Improve How Institutions Work:**

  Assess governance structures, institutional arrangements, and administrative processes to identify gaps and shape practical reforms.
* **Bring Stakeholders Together:**

  Coordinate with departments, agencies, and external partners to move cross-cutting government initiatives forward.
* **Make Complex Ideas Clear:**

  Prepare concise presentations, briefing notes, and decision-support materials for senior government stakeholders.
* **Engage on the Ground:**

  Participate in meetings, consultations, reviews, and workshops with government officials, departments, and public institutions.

**Why Pravi?**

* **Be in the Room Where Change Happens**

  : Work directly on live policy and governance initiatives with government institutions and contribute to policies, programmes, and decisions that shape outcomes
* **Turn Ideas into Action**

  : Follow the journey from concept notes and strategy to implementation on the ground
* **Learn at Accelerated Speed**

  : Gain hands-on exposure to public administration, programme design, and project management
* **Grow Through Ownership**

  : Take on meaningful responsibility, receive close mentorship, and engage with clients early in your career

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for intellectually curious problem-solvers who are excited by complex challenges, interested in governance and public policy, and motivated to create impact at scale.

The ideal candidate should have:

* A strong academic background in law, public policy, economics, political science, sociology, public administration, development studies, or related disciplines, with an interest in research and evidence-based problem-solving
* Proven ability to conduct structured research, analyse complex issues, and translate insights into practical solutions
* A natural knack for breaking down messy problems, asking sharp questions, and taking ownership of deliverables
* 0–2 years of experience for Analyst roles; 3–6 years for Senior Analyst roles
* Comfort with policy research, data synthesis, stakeholder engagement, and navigating ambiguity
* Excellent analytical writing, communication, and presentation skills
* The ability to thrive in fast-paced environments
* Prior exposure to government, public policy, or the development sector is a plus
* Experience preparing for or appearing in UPSC or State Public Service examinations is a plus
* Knowledge of Gujarati is a plus, but not mandatory

description:
Hiring: Project Quality Engineer

Location: Sanand, Gujarat, India

Industry: Automotive Manufacturing

Department: Quality / New Product Development

Reporting to: Project Manager(s)

Experience: 3–6 years (automotive manufacturing preferred)

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Project Quality Engineer to manage quality planning and execution throughout the project lifecycle, from new product development and customer approval to production launch and final handover. The role will work closely with Project Managers and cross-functional teams to ensure product quality, compliance with customer-specific requirements, timely completion of quality deliverables, and readiness for mass production.

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Quality Planning

\* Develop and maintain project-specific quality plans, inspection plans, and quality deliverables in line with customer requirements.

\* Prepare and coordinate APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) activities and maintain project quality milestones.

\* Coordinate the preparation and review of PFMEA, DFMEA inputs, Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, and Process Capability studies.

\* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, and applicable automotive quality standards.

\* Identify project quality risks and coordinate preventive actions with relevant stakeholders.

2. New Product Development & Launch

\* Coordinate quality activities from prototype and sample development through validation, customer approval, and mass-production launch.

\* Plan and monitor prototype, pre-launch, and production-stage inspections and testing.

\* Coordinate PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) documentation and submission, including dimensional reports, material and performance test reports, MSA, SPC, and other applicable requirements.

\* Ensure timely closure of customer observations and approval-related open points.

\* Verify process readiness and quality documentation before production handover.

3. Cross-Functional Project Coordination

\* Work closely with Project Managers, Production, Process Engineering, Design/R&D, Supplier Quality, Purchase, and Customer Quality teams.

\* Track quality-related project milestones, deliverables, risks, and pending actions.

\* Participate in project review meetings and provide updates on quality status, delays, risks, and corrective actions.

\* Coordinate trial runs, pilot production, engineering changes, and validation activities.

\* Ensure changes to drawings, specifications, materials, processes, and tooling are assessed, approved, and documented before implementation.

4. Problem Solving & Corrective Actions

\* Lead or coordinate root-cause analysis for project-related defects and launch issues using 5 Why, Fishbone, 8D, and other structured problem-solving methods.

\* Monitor containment, corrective, and preventive actions and verify their effectiveness.

\* Coordinate resolution of dimensional, material, functional, and process-related quality issues.

\* Maintain a lessons-learned register and ensure recurring issues are prevented in subsequent projects.

5. Supplier & Customer Quality Coordination

\* Coordinate with Supplier Quality and suppliers on new component development, supplier PPAP, sample approval, and supplier-related project issues.

\* Support customer audits, process audits, product audits, and quality reviews as required.

\* Ensure customer-specific quality documentation and approval requirements are completed on time.

\* Facilitate timely closure of customer complaints or concerns associated with new launches and project changes.

6. Production Readiness & Documentation

\* Verify availability and completeness of inspection standards, Control Plans, work instructions, gauges, measuring equipment, and quality records before launch.

\* Monitor trial production results, first-off inspections, dimensional conformity, and process capability.

\* Ensure measurement systems are validated and inspection equipment is calibrated.

\* Maintain traceability of samples, inspection results, approvals, deviations, and engineering changes.

\* Support safe and controlled transition from project development to regular production.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\* On-time completion of project quality milestones and deliverables.

\* On-time PPAP submission and customer approval.

\* First-pass yield and right-first-time performance during trials and launch.

\* Number and severity of launch-related defects and customer complaints.

\* Timely closure and effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions.

\* Compliance with APQP, Control Plan, PFMEA, and other required quality documentation.

\* Supplier quality approval and incoming quality performance for new projects.

\* Reduction in repeat defects, rework, and scrap attributable to project or launch issues.

\* Audit findings and timely closure of non-conformities.

\* Production handover completed with all mandatory quality approvals and documentation.

Required Qualifications & Skills

\* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Automobile, or a related engineering discipline.

\* 3–6 years of experience in quality engineering within automotive or precision manufacturing.

\* Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, 8D, and root-cause analysis.

\* Familiarity with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, and customer-specific requirements.

\* Experience with dimensional inspection, engineering drawings, GD&T, and measuring instruments.

\* Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage multiple project deliverables.

\* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

\* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and quality documentation systems.

Preferred Experience

\* Experience in automotive OEM or Tier-1 manufacturing environments.

\* Exposure to new product development, process validation, pilot runs, and mass-production launches.

\* Experience with metal components, formed or fabricated parts, machining, wheel/rim assemblies, or similar automotive products.

India is in the middle of one of the largest energy transitions in the world. Decisions being taken now on storage, renewables, energy efficiency, clean fuels and carbon markets will shape how the country produces and uses energy for decades. You will help shape policies, programmes and implement them in renewable energy, energy storage, energy efficiency, carbon markets and clean fuels. You will assist in research of what works, support decisions, set up the systems that put those decisions into action, and work directly with senior officials and industry leaders.
